business_summary: Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. engages in forestry business in Japan, the United States, Australia, China, Indonesia, New Zealand, and internationally. It operates through the Timber Building Materials Business; Housing Business; Construction and Real Estate Business; and Resources and Environment Business segments. The Timber Building Materials Business segment purchases, manufactures, processes, and sells timber, including logs, chips, timber, laminated timber, and building materials, consisting of plywood, fiberboard, processed wood composite materials, ceramic building materials, metal building materials, and housing equipment. The Housing Business segment is involved in the contracting, after-sales maintenance, and renovation of construction work for single-family homes and apartment complexes, sales of condominiums, real estate development, leasing, management, buying and selling, and brokerage of real estate, contracting of external structures and landscaping work for housing, urban greening business, CAD, and site surveys. The Construction and Real Estate Business segment sells overseas condominiums, constructs single-family homes, develops housing complexes and commercial complexes, and provides contracting for medium- to large-scale construction work. The Resources and Environment Business segment engages in the renewable energy business, forest resource business. The company was founded in 1691 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 스미토모 임업 주식회사는 일본, 미국, 호주, 중국, 인도네시아, 뉴질랜드 및 국제적으로 임업 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 목재 건축자재 사업을 통해 운영됩니다. 주택사업; 건설 및 부동산 사업; 자원 및 환경 사업 부문. 목재 건축자재 사업 부문은 합판, 섬유판, 가공 목재 복합 재료, 세라믹 건축 자재, 금속 건축 자재 및 주택 장비로 구성된 원목, 칩, 목재, 적층 목재 및 건축 자재를 포함한 목재를 구매, 제조, 가공 및 판매합니다. 주택사업부문은 단독주택 및 아파트 단지 건설공사의 도급, 사후관리, 개축공사, 맨션 매매, 부동산 개발, 부동산 임대, 관리, 매매, 중개, 주택 외부구조물 도급 및 조경공사, 도시녹화사업, CAD, 현장조사 등의 업무를 수행하고 있습니다. 건설부동산사업부문은 해외 콘도 매각, 단독주택 건설, 주택단지 개발, 상업시설 개발 등을 하고 있습니다.
